title: Clypzo: Screen Video Recorder
summary: Screen Video recorder with audio, facecam, tutorials - record gameplay in HD Pro
description:
🎥 Clypzo – Screen Video Recorder, Screen Recording & Video Recorder (Screen Capture) with Audio, Internal Audio, Facecam, No Watermark, 1080p/1440p, 60FPS/144FPS + Draw on Screen

Clypzo is an easy-to-use screen recorder for Android that lets you record screen videos and screen capture gameplay, tutorials, video calls, and online classes in HD 1080p / 1440p.

Made for gamers, creators, teachers, and professionals, Clypzo supports screen recording with audio (including internal audio), facecam recording, no-watermark videos, smooth 60FPS / 144FPS recording, and on-screen drawing tools while you record.

⭐ Key Features
🎬 Screen Recorder in HD & Full HD (1080p / 1440p)
• Record screen videos in HD, Full HD, and up to 1440p at up to 144 FPS
• Smooth screen recording with no lag or stutter
• High-quality video recorder for games and apps

🔊 Screen Recorder with Audio (Internal Audio Screen Recorder)
• Record internal audio (device sound) on Android 10+
• Record microphone audio for voice narration
• Ideal for gameplay recorder clips, tutorials, and presentations

📷 Screen Recorder with Facecam
• Record your screen with front or back camera
• Add live reactions while recording gameplay
• Great for YouTube, tutorials, and explanation videos

✏️ Draw on Screen While Recording / Screen Markup
• Draw arrows, lines, and circles during screen recording
• Highlight important areas in real time
• Best for tutorials, online classes, and training videos

🎮 Record Anything on Your Screen (Screen Capture)
• Gameplay videos (game recorder / gameplay recorder)
• App demos
• Video calls
• Online meetings & classes
• Tutorials and presentations

🚫 No Watermark. No Time Limit. No Root.
• No watermark screen recorder (no watermark on videos or screenshots)
• No recording time limit
• No root required
• Record unlimited screen videos for free

✂️ Built-in Video Editor
Edit your screen recordings without leaving the app:
• Trim/cut, merge clips
• Add background music or voice-over
• Change speed (slow/fast)
• Crop and rotate

📸 Screenshot & Image Editing Tool
• One-tap screenshots
• Crop images
• Draw, add text/emojis, highlight areas

🚀 Why Choose Clypzo?
✔ Free screen recorder with audio
✔ Internal audio screen recorder + mic support
✔ Game recorder / gameplay recorder with facecam
✔ No watermark screen recorder
✔ 1080p / 1440p + 60fps / 120fps recording support
✔ Draw & screen markup while recording
✔ Easy, fast, reliable screen recording + screen capture

Download Clypzo – Game & Screen Recorder today and capture your screen, gameplay, tutorials, and important moments effortlessly.
